set.body: Covering everything makes the plan a second full API to maintain; covering only what the GUI constructs risks a capability gap. Proposal: detection, estimation, AOI definition, comparison and pairing — adapters and custom measures as opaque referenced extensions. HOLD THE RULE: plan node parameters are typed domain values, never Map[String,String]; an inexpressible operation is a missing plan node, not a reason to add a dynamic one. Must close by v0.65.
set.title: DECISION OD-8: how much of the API must the plan ADT cover?
